problems.description: New regression from patch 70 (ea13b10). Renaming a property or object key whose name starts with `$` now gives wrong edits, and the edits disagree from one file to the next. `store_value_text` (tsgo_rename.rs:682, called at :302) adds `$` to every rename edit that replaces a `$name` in a component. It assumes that "a `$` name in a component is always a store's value". That holds for variables only. It does not hold for a member such as `d.$id` or a key such as `{ $set: … }`. `prepare_rename_plan` (tsgo_rename.rs:149) also treats any `$x` token as a store, so the rename box shows the name without its `$`.
problems.evidence:
Case file /private/tmp/claude-501/-Users-hyprsonic-Developer-hyprsonic-uk--experiments-zeno/957f62ce-c5e3-468e-b125-e60c604064fd/scratchpad/rev7/corpus3/dollar.json, run with rnq.mjs. Results are in .../rev7/res3/dollar.{ours,base,off}.json. The case: doc.ts has `type Doc = { $id: string; … }`. The component has `{#each docs as d (d.$id)}

{d.$id}…`, `{current?.$id}`, `const query = { $set: {…} }` and `{query.$set.title}`. - prepareRename at `d.$id` returns range 7:32-7:34 with placeholder `id`. - Renaming to `ident`: c921b00 writes `ident` in doc.ts but `$ident` at all three component uses. The type no longer matches its uses. 8c8c100 wrote `ident` at the uses (it missed only the each key, before patch 75). Official writes `ident` everywhere. - Renaming to `id`: doc.ts becomes `id`, and the component edits are no-ops (`$id` -> `$id`). - Renaming `$set` to `set` is a no-op. Renaming it to `update` gives `$update`. - 8c8c100 matched official for `$set`.
problems.fix:
In tsgo_rename.rs, treat a `$name` as a store value only when both hold:
1. It is an identifier reference: no `.` or `?.` before it, ignoring whitespace, and it is not an object-literal key followed by `:`.
2. The shadow declares `let $name = __sveltets_2_store_get(name);`, the shape `store_counterpart` already recognises.

Apply this test in `store_value_text` and before setting `is_store_value` in `prepare_rename_plan`, so a property's prepare range keeps its `$`.

Test: the dollar case. Renaming `d.$id` to `ident` should edit doc.ts and every use, including the each key, to `ident`. `query.$set` should rename like official.

problems.description: Pre-existing (also on 8c8c100). A rename can edit files outside the workspace and the server's own generated files. `rewrite_workspace_edit` (tsgo_rename.rs:253-259) passes every edit whose URI is not a shadow through unchanged. When tsgo returns edits in tsrs's bundled lib.dom.d.ts or in `.svelte-rs/tsgo/svelte-shims-v4.d.ts`, they reach the editor. Zed opens and edits those files; saving them would break tsrs's DOM types or the shims.
problems.evidence:
Results are in /private/tmp/claude-501/-Users-hyprsonic-Developer-hyprsonic-uk--experiments-zeno/957f62ce-c5e3-468e-b125-e60c604064fd/scratchpad/rev7/res, res2 and res4 (`*.ours.json` against `*.off.json`).

- Renaming the string literal `"a"` in `export type Kind = "a" | "b"` (corpus/module.json, Mod.svelte:47) adds three edits to /Users/hyprsonic/.bun/install/global/node_modules/@tsrs/darwin-arm64/lib.dom.d.ts, at 43099:5, 43246:5 and 43312:5. These are the `"a"` keys of HTMLElementTagNameMap and similar maps.
- `"b"` gives 43106:5. `$state("div")` gives 43127:5 (corpus4/diredge.json). `$state("a")` behaves the same.
- Official 0.18.5 returns only the component edits, although its references also list the lib locations.
- In a legacy component, renaming at `size` in `$: twice = size * 2;` returns one edit: `.svelte-rs/tsgo/svelte-shims-v4.d.ts` [6117-6140] -> `sizeQ`, a rename of `__sveltets_2_invalidate` (corpus/props.json, Legacy.svelte:119).
- 8c8c100 returns the same edits.
problems.fix:
In `rewrite_workspace_edit`, drop an edit whose URI is not a shadow when it is:
- inside an overlay cache directory (`.svelte-rs/`),
- inside `node_modules`, or
- outside every workspace folder (this covers tsgo's bundled `lib.*.d.ts`).

If the renamed symbol's own declaration is among the dropped edits, reject the rename as TypeScript does for library symbols.

Test: renaming `"a"` of `type Kind = "a" | "b"` in a component should edit only that component.

problems.description:
Pre-existing (legacy-mode components). The projection overwrites the whole right-hand side of `$: x = expr` (reactive.rs:114: `str.overwrite(rhs_abs_start, rhs_abs_end, &wrapped_rhs)`), so identifiers there have no mapping. Two things go wrong:
- A rename from a declaration silently skips most uses inside `$:` statements, and the component no longer compiles.
- A rename from inside the right-hand side renames `__sveltets_2_invalidate` in the shims file.

Upstream ImplicitTopLevelNames keeps the right-hand side in place.
problems.evidence:
Case: /private/tmp/claude-501/-Users-hyprsonic-Developer-hyprsonic-uk--experiments-zeno/957f62ce-c5e3-468e-b125-e60c604064fd/scratchpad/rev7/corpus2/reactive.json. Results: .../rev7/res2/reactive.{ours,base,off}.json.

- Renaming `export let price` from its declaration edits 5 places. It misses four, which official renames:
  - `$: ({ a, b } = { a: price, b: qty })`
  - `$: [first, second] = [price, qty]`
  - `` $: label = `${qty} x ${price}` ``
  - `$: obj = { price, qty }` (official gives `price: priceQ`)
- Renaming `qty` misses 5 uses.
- From 12 positions inside these right-hand sides, the only edit returned is to `.svelte-rs/tsgo/svelte-shims-v4.d.ts`.
- prepareRename there offers placeholder `__sveltets_2_invalidate`, with range 4:12-4:35, which runs past the end of the line.
- Results are identical on 8c8c100.
problems.fix:
In rsvelte_projection/src/svelte2tsx/script/reactive.rs, keep the right-hand side in place as upstream does:
- `prepend_left(rhs_start, "__sveltets_2_invalidate(() => ")`, with an extra `(` for an object literal or an `as` expression;
- `append_right(rhs_end, ")")`, or `))` with the extra `(`.

Check the generated code is byte-identical with the existing corpus probe (zz_probe.rs, corpus.sh, cmpcode.py).

Test: renaming `price` from its declaration and from inside the right-hand side should edit every use in the component.

problems.description:
Pre-existing, partly widened by patch 77 (6e85421). Template positions without a mapping are sent to the nearest earlier mapped text, so requests there answer for a different symbol:
- `map_source_position` (tsgo_overlay.rs:1797) falls back to `closest_source_token`.
- `prepare_rename_plan` falls back to `source_map_source_to_generated`.

Rename then edits an unrelated symbol (the prepare answer moves the rename box to the other name). Hover, definition, references and highlights answer for the neighbour.

Patch 77 extends this to a `class:` or `style:` directive's name written before a later attribute: in common runes code, hovering a class name now shows the previous directive's variable.
problems.evidence:
Tools are in /private/tmp/claude-501/-Users-hyprsonic-Developer-hyprsonic-uk--experiments-zeno/957f62ce-c5e3-468e-b125-e60c604064fd/scratchpad/rev7/tools: prep.mjs, rnq.mjs and hoverat.mjs. Cases are in .../rev7/corpus2 (bindthis.json, events.json), .../rev7/corpus (legacy.json, components.json) and .../rev7/corpus3 (classname.json, placement.json). Rename (all the same on 8c8c100): - At `thing` in ``: prepare offers placeholder `"n"` on another symbol. Rename turns Thing.svelte's `let { n = 0 }` into `{ thingQ: n = 0 }` and every `n={…}` attribute into `thingQ={…}`. - At `things` in `bind:this={things[ki]}`: renames the each item `k`. - At `pick`, `e` or `picked` in ` (picked = e.detail.id)} />`: renames the import `Emitter` and every ``: renames `list` (placeholder `list`). - At `head` in ``: renames the `title` prop. - At the `bind` keyword of ``: renames `kind`. Hover and definition, on `
`: - Hovering `disabled` shows `let isSel: false`, and go to definition jumps to `let isSel`. - Hovering `color` shows `let dis`. - 8c8c100 returned null for this form; official returns null. - For directives written after every attribute (`

`), 8c8c100 already showed `let aa` / `let bb`. Official returns null. - In the corpora, the number of reference, highlight and definition locations not on the queried name rose from 93 to 101 in diredge (positions such as `class:x-y`, `style:color|important`).
problems.fix:
Make both fallbacks check that they still point at the same text:
(a) In `prepare_rename_plan`, after mapping, require the generated text at `generated_offset` to begin with `name`. A `$store` is already shifted past its `$`. Otherwise return `Reject(UnmappedPosition)`.
(b) In `map_source_position`, when there is no exact mapping, accept `closest_source_token` only if the source text from the token's start to the cursor equals the generated text over the same length; then add the offset. Otherwise return None.

Tests: each position above should answer null or refuse the rename. The existing rename, hover and e2e suites should be unchanged.

problems.description: Pre-existing (legacy `export let` components). Renaming a legacy component's prop from a parent's attribute corrupts the parent and leaves the child unchanged. In `collect_generated_followups` (tsgo_rename.rs:432-451), `prop_key_before` looks back for the nearest `:`. When tsgo's edit is on a key rather than a value, that colon belongs to the previous `key: value` pair, so the follow-up renames the previous prop.
problems.evidence:
Case: /private/tmp/claude-501/-Users-hyprsonic-Developer-hyprsonic-uk--experiments-zeno/957f62ce-c5e3-468e-b125-e60c604064fd/scratchpad/rev7/corpus/props.json, query ParentP.svelte:341. The tsrs traffic is captured in .../rev7/tee/tsrs-out.log.

- Renaming `size` in `<Legacy {label} size={count} bind:this={leg} />` gives `<Legacy sizeQ={label} sizeQ={count} …>`. Svelte rejects it: "Attributes need to be unique".
- Legacy.svelte is not edited.
- Official renames `size` in Legacy.svelte (4 places) and the attribute.
- Captured traffic: tsgo correctly renames the key `size` in Legacy's `props: {label: label , size: size , …}`, at 11:32 and 11:78.
- The server then sends follow-ups at 11:17 and 11:63, which are `label`. Their answer `sizeQ: label` becomes `sizeQ={label}` through `correct_shorthand`.
- Identical on 8c8c100.
problems.fix:
In `prop_key_before`, accept the colon only when nothing but whitespace lies between it and `value_start`. Otherwise return None, so the follow-up falls through to `find_generated_let` or is not sent.

Test: renaming `size` from `<Legacy {label} size={count}>` should edit Legacy.svelte's declaration and uses, and only the `size` attribute in the parent.

problems.description: Pre-existing. A component's `bind:this={expr}` is written into the generated code as plain text by `build_component_bind_suffix` (inline_component.rs:56-100), so it has no mapping. Renaming the variable from its declaration leaves the binding behind, and the component no longer compiles. Positions inside the expression map to a neighbouring symbol, as in the problem above. Patch 77 mapped this only for elements.
problems.evidence:
Case: /private/tmp/claude-501/-Users-hyprsonic-Developer-hyprsonic-uk--experiments-zeno/957f62ce-c5e3-468e-b125-e60c604064fd/scratchpad/rev7/corpus2/bindthis.json.

- Renaming `let thing` edits the declaration and `thing?.bump()`. It misses `<Thing bind:this={thing} />` and `<Thing {...props} bind:this={thing} n={3} />`.
- `other` and `things[ki]` are missed the same way.
- Official renames all of them.
- The same happens in corpus/components.json (`bind:this={comp}`) and corpus/props.json (`bind:this={leg}`).
- Identical on 8c8c100.
problems.fix:
Emit the expression as a mapped copy of its source range (`MagicString::insert_copy`, as patch 77 does), followed by ` = {inst_var};`. Do the same for the get/set form, `({get, set})(inst)`.

Check byte-identical code with the corpus probe.

Test: renaming `thing` should edit both `bind:this={thing}` uses, and no rename at a position inside the expression should reach a different symbol.

problems.description: New behaviour from patch 68 (f167318). The "nothing since" liveness rule restarts a tsrs that is slow but still answering when two things hold: the slow request is the only one in flight, and no pull of its document is with tsgo. One overdue request cannot tell slow from stuck. 8c8c100 did not restart here.
problems.evidence:
Probe: /private/tmp/claude-501/-Users-hyprsonic-Developer-hyprsonic-uk--experiments-zeno/957f62ce-c5e3-468e-b125-e60c604064fd/scratchpad/rev7/tools/slowquiet.mjs. It uses slowsig's 6-alias module with a client that supports pulls but sends one definition 1 s after open and nothing else, with RSVELTE_TSGO_REQUEST_TIMEOUT_MS=3000.

- c921b00 logs `restarting tsgo, which is still busy with nothing since textDocument/definition (2)`. signatureHelp behaves the same.
- 8c8c100 does not restart.
- With a 20 s timeout the definition is answered at 7.6 s, so tsrs was only slow.
- No restart happens for a client that takes pushed diagnostics, or after an editor-cancelled pull (the server keeps that pull with tsgo).
- At the default 30 s timeout this needs a request slower than 30 s with no pull of its document in flight, which is rare; patches.md lists it under patch 68's Risks.
problems.fix:
In `tsgo_restart_candidates` (server.rs:3570, rule at :3613), use the "nothing since" rule only when a later non-pull request, sent after the overdue one, has also gone unanswered for some time (for example 1 s, or one timeout).
- A stuck tsrs still restarts on the editor's next request.
- A lone slow request does not.
- The missedloop cases keep their restarts: hovers there go unanswered, and the suspect rule is unchanged.

Test: a robustness test where the fake tsgo answers one request after two timeouts with nothing else asked should see no restart.

problems.description: Pre-existing. tsgo keeps the language id a buffer was first opened with, and the server sends a language change as a didChange. A component opened without `lang="ts"` and then given `lang="ts"` stays checked as JavaScript for the rest of the session: false 8010/8016 errors, and no real TypeScript errors. This is also the cause of the lsfuzz2 final-state mismatches that the previous review and the integration called a comparison artifact.
problems.evidence:
Probe: /private/tmp/claude-501/-Users-hyprsonic-Developer-hyprsonic-uk--experiments-zeno/957f62ce-c5e3-468e-b125-e60c604064fd/scratchpad/rev7/tools/langflip.mjs. It opens `<script>` and then changes it to `<script lang="ts">` with `const n: number = "x"; let m = n as string;`.

- c921b00 and 8c8c100 report 8010 'Type annotations can only be used in TypeScript files' and 8016, with no 2322 or 2352.
- The same text opened fresh reports 2322 and 2352, and official reports them after the change.
- In lsfuzz2, seeds 30 and 36 (default timeout) and 12 and 37 (3 s timeout) differ only in this way, after a restart. The documents were reopened while their text lacked `lang="ts"`: there are extra 8004/8016 errors, or missing semantic errors.
problems.fix:
In tsgo_client.rs (`ClientCommand::Open | Change`, line 650): when the retained buffer's `language_id` differs from the new one, send didClose and then didOpen with the new language id and text, instead of didChange.

Test: the langflip sequence should report 2322 and 2352 after the change.

**The seven ship-review problems**
1. Missed loop: fixed by patches 67 and 68. Liveness results are below.
2. Closing tags: fixed by patch 73. `</Kid>` and `</Lib.Box>` match official, as do odd spacing, `</Kid\n>`, nesting and `</K.Kid >`.
3. Snippets, each keys and indexes, class/style shorthands: fixed by patches 74–77, 79 and 80. The extra edge cases also match official (`(rows as Row[])`, rest patterns, keys with brackets and comments, `<T,>`, `keyof` constraints, padded and comment-bearing headers). Where they differ, official is the one that corrupts (`pairDimT`, `{` -> `childrenQ`).
   - The review's showMessage warning for partial renames was explicitly deferred. Unmapped copies still remain: a component's `bind:this`, legacy `$:` right-hand sides, `on:` handlers on components, and JSDoc `$props` types. Problems 3 and 6 above cover the first two.
4. `bind:` shorthand: fixed by patch 69 when renaming from the declaration. The class/style expansion (`class:active={on}`) is deliberate and documented.
5. `$store`: fixed by patches 70 and 71, but patch 70 caused the `$`-property regression in problem 1.
6. Diagnostic before the alias copy: fixed by patch 72. TypeOpenGen reports at 2:12 and TypeOpenTypeof at 3:12; official is one column earlier.
7. Repaired alias: fixed by patch 78. BadAnnot reports only Svelte's parse error; BadAnnot2 reports 2314 at 1:17-1:22.
   - Diagnostics for directives placed before a later attribute (corpus3/diag4.json) land nearer official's positions than on 8c8c100.

**Rename corpus**
- 1,761 auto-generated queries in 28 case files, run against c921b00, 8c8c100 and official 0.18.5. Covered: components and namespaces, snippets, each, directives, CRLF, unicode, stores, props, legacy, generics, module and context="module" scripts, cross-file .ts and closed components, `bind:this`, dynamic components, `on:`, awaits and attributes.
- c921b00 against official: 1,177 identical and 308 both-none (8c8c100: 754 and 310). The rest:
  - 67 diff: patch 69's expansions, snippet type parameters, lib.dom edits, legacy, `bind:this` and neighbour targets.
  - 55 where official gives nothing: mostly ours being right (`import { fade as fadeQ }`, `<T>` in snippets).
  - 110 where we give nothing and 44 subsets of official's edits.
- Compared with 8c8c100, no query got worse except the patch 70 `$`-property case and the deliberate `class:d={dQ}` expansion.
- Missing edits (secondary):
  - Renaming at a directive's name (`bind:value`, `class:on`, `use:act`) returns null, because `is_native_html_name` (tsgo_rename.rs:770) rejects it, although references there are correct.
  - Renaming a component prop misses an explicit `bind:prop={x}`.
  - `<svelte:body use:act>` is missed (official misses it too).

**Liveness on c921b00**
- lsfuzz2, seeds 1–40 × 300 iterations, four at a time: run once at the default timeout and once at 3 s.
  - No panic or exit, no request unanswered or answered twice.
  - Only seeds 12, 22, 30, 36 and 37 restart. Each restart is for a loop the model flags ("loops on").
  - No restart came from the new liveness rules.
  - The remaining final-state mismatches are problem 8 above.
- missedloop with a 4 s timeout:
  - regex case, and the `if (r) /'/` case with 4 completions (also SAME=1): one restart at 4 s, hovers 1–3 ms afterwards.
  - One or two completions on the missed case: restart at about 16 s, hovers answered throughout, tsrs at 100–200% CPU until then.
- loopstorm: 3 restarts, hovers 1 ms. pullwhileloop: every pull answered at once with 186 TS diagnostics, restart at about 5 s.
- slowsig signature and definition, and slowmix (3 s timeout): no restart, TS2322 at 7 s.
- slowsig with 36 aliases at the default timeout: null at 32 s, no restart, TS2322 at 42 s.
- The one slow-request restart found is problem 7 above.

**Prevalence in zeno** (read-only grep)
- 0 `$:` statements, 0 `.$` members, 0 `on:` directives on components, 1 component `bind:this`.
- So problems 1, 3, 5 and 6 barely touch the user's own code. Problem 4's hover regression does: class and style directives before a later attribute are common there.
